text: Official API is bundled with the desktop app and runs fully offline on localhost
quote: Our API is now available and directly included with the desktop app, running entirely on localhost. It operates fully offline

text: Official CLI lets you run Anytype as a headless server for scripting/automation
quote: Anytype CLI is now available - run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting.

text: AI assistants can drive the API using natural-language commands
quote: enabling AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Anytype's API through natural language.

text: API supports creating chats, sending/streaming messages, reacting, and searching chat history
quote: Create chats, send and stream messages, react, and search chat history (anytype-heart v0.50.7)

text: An agent can run scripts against your data programmatically for bulk edits and repetitive tasks
quote: the agent can run scripts against your Anytype data — programmatically — to handle bulk edits, transformations, and repetitive tasks

text: You can back up channels/data to a self-hosted network with your own network configuration
quote: To back up your channels and data to a self-hosted network, you need to have a network configuration.

text: Local-only mode disables the backup node entirely, syncing only over the local network
quote: This mode disables Anytype's backup node entirely—meaning multi-device syncing will only work over the same local network

text: Queries answer questions against your knowledge base instantly and stay up to date automatically
quote: A Query is a question you ask your knowledge base—answered instantly and kept up to date automatically.

text: The Graph gives a live visual map of every object in a Channel and their connections
quote: The Graph is a live, visual map of every Object in your Channel and how they connect to each other.

text: Web Publishing turns any Object into a public webpage at a URL
quote: Web Publishing lets you turn any Object into a public webpage at a URL anyone can visit.

text: Import/export supports choosing between Markdown or Any-Block format
quote: Choose your preferred format: Markdown or Any-Block.

text: You can collaborate with others while retaining privacy
quote: Anytype lets you collaborate with others without sacrificing your privacy.

text: Templates are saved, reusable page layouts you can apply
quote: A Template is a saved layout for a page that you can reuse.

text: Markdown import automatically creates a separate object for each file
quote: Anytype will process the contents and automatically create a separate object for each Markdown file.

text: An open-source MCP toolkit gives AI assistants a safe way to read, search, and modify Objects
quote: gives AI assistants a safe way to read, search, and modify Objects in your Anytype Channels

text: A team-maintained Docker image is available for self-hosting
quote: There's also a docker image that's maintained by the team.

text: You can import content into spaces and export it at any time
quote: You can import content into your spaces and export it at any time.

text: 12-word recovery Key acts as a permanent, non-resettable identity credential
quote: Your Key is a 12-word phrase that can never be changed or reset.

text: Content is only readable by you and those you explicitly share with
quote: Only you, and the people you choose to share with, can read it.

text: Object connections let you trace relationships between ideas and projects
quote: These connections become incredibly valuable. You can trace how ideas relate, see what's connected to a project

text: All content is stored locally on-device for an offline-first experience that always works without internet
quote: All your content is stored locally on your device... This means an offline-first experience: the app always works without an internet connection

text: Only you can access your spaces and grant access — not even Anytype can see your content
quote: Only you can access your spaces and grant access to others — not even Anytype can see your content.

text: Anytype ships built-in Types and lets you create custom Types to match your needs
quote: Anytype comes with built-in Types, but you can create your own custom Types to match your needs.

text: Collaborators can join without providing email, buying a subscription, or asking permission
quote: Collaborators don't need to provide an email address, buy a subscription, or ask anyone for permission.

text: Publishing generates a static HTML page hosted on your own subdomain
quote: Pick an Object, click Publish, and Anytype generates a static HTML page hosted on your personal subdomain at .any.org/

text: Obsidian vaults can be imported directly via Import → Obsidian
quote: Open Channel Settings → Import → Obsidian and click on Import files.

text: Agent tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or GitHub Copilot can run scripts against your Anytype data
quote: Drop it into Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, or any other agent-capable tool, and the agent can run scripts against your Anytype data

text: Composable blocks include text, databases, kanban boards, calendars, and custom Types
quote: Composable blocks: text, databases, kanban, calendar & custom Types.

text: System is extensible through a gRPC API and AI 'Agents'
quote: Extensible through a gRPC API and AI "Agents" (see AGENTS.md).

text: You can collaborate via peer-to-peer sync or by self-hosting on your own network
quote: You can even collaborate directly with others using peer-to-peer sync or self-host on your own network.

text: Linking notes turns separate pages into a connected knowledge base
quote: Linking on Anytype is what turns a bunch of separate notes into a connected knowledge base.

text: A custom ANY ID handle can be used for your web publishing URLs
quote: Include a custom ANY ID — your unique handle, used for web publishing URLs

text: Infrastructure automatically handles background syncing and backups while you retain data ownership
quote: Our infrastructure handles background syncing and backups automatically, so you retain full ownership of your data without compromising your sovereignty.

text: A Vault is an encrypted, user-owned container storing everything directly on-device
quote: A Vault is an encrypted container in Anytype that you own. Everything you create lives inside your Vault, stored directly on your device.

text: You can fully switch to local-only mode with no server syncing between desktop and mobile
quote: If you prefer to fully keep your data on your device without any server to sync between your desktop and mobile, you can enable local-only mode.
